d: In this video, Firstpost explains how violent protests in France have turned into an unexpected marketing opportunity for a Chinese glassmaker. Footage showing masked men repeatedly smashing a shopfront window in Paris, without managing to break through, has gone viral. Hengxinfeng Special-Glass, a manufacturer of high-security glass based in China’s Henan province, has repurposed the clip to showcase its products. The company specialises in laminated glass designed to withstand heavy impacts. But was the glass actually made by Hengxinfeng? We look at the viral footage, the company’s…
